answer: A strong defense is stake-backed reputation with slashing. Each agent locks a deposit before earning, and its work is graded by random peers; bad work burns part of the stake. A Sybil swarm looks soft as velvet at first, but every fake identity must fund its own deposit, so the attacker cost multiplies with each copy. Honest agents climb steadily, while fakes stand on a ledge: one failed audit pushes them off, and their stake falls into a canyon of burned deposits, never to return.
